intro: Same prompt, four AIs, and us. Entertainment only. Graded at the DraftKings line each side was asked.
prompt_note: PROVISIONAL BOARD: asked Wednesday Nov 18, 2026 (prompt sent about 2:25 to 2:30 PM PT) on the DraftKings line fetched at 1:16 PM PT, before the Westgate SuperContest card was out. This is not a Westgate run. MIN vs SF is in Mexico City (neutral). Byes: ATL, CLE, GB, LAR, NE, SEA. Each AI got the identical prompt and picked all 13 games with a 1-10 confidence, three Best Bets and a ranked top 5. Gemini's first attempt returned an error and was rerun in a new chat; its rerun said it had no live data, set every game to the DraftKings number and called all 13 games coin flips, so its sides are mechanical tiebreaks, shown exactly as given. Grok took the favorite in all 13 games, sometimes against its own stated number; its picks are shown exactly as given. Vector's sides are leans from a provisional model update (injury layer not fully re-reconciled); its top 5 is provisional and it has no Best Bets until the Westgate card posts. Vector's MIA and PHI sides are model leans only, kept so every game has a side, and are excluded from its top 5. All 13 games are pending.
line_source: DraftKings line, Wednesday Nov 18, 2026 (fetched 1:16 PM PT)
score_source: ESPN NFL scoreboard (https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/scoreboard?week=11&seasontype=2&dates=2026). Only games with status final are stored. No Week 11 finals stored yet.
